headline: Vivo Confirms Non-Binding Talks to Acquire Internet Provider Vero
summary: Telefônica Brasil confirmed it is holding non-binding discussions regarding the potential acquisition of internet service provider Vero following inquiries from securities regulators.
why: Consolidation in the telecommunications sector reshapes broadband market shares, competitive pricing dynamics, and corporate valuations.

impacts.name: Telefônica Brasil
impacts.why: Corporate acquisition talks can cause short-term valuation adjustments based on deal synergies and transaction costs.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Potential M&A announcements alter market expectations regarding corporate scale and competitive positioning.
